action: Close the restaurant pilot. Call them directly — not a message, a call — and make the ask binary: 'I want to know if the 60-day pilot at $300/month makes sense for you right now. Frame it around this week's reality: consumer spending is at 30% of baseline, people in residential areas are now moving around via RoboRide, and lunch spots that are visible and human on social media capture the foot traffic that used to stop for gas first. I am not a dealership employee with a side project anymore. I am a full-time freelance consultant. That framing change matters. A yes on this call brings me to $650/month and proves the two-client model.
